jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Identity Governance & Administration
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
 Working With Us 
 Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients and the careers of those who do it. Join us and make a difference.
 Position Summary 
 The Senior Analyst, Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and maintaining enterprise Identity Governance capabilities with a primary focus on Access Reviews, Certification Campaigns, governance processes, and compliance controls.
 This role will work closely with business stakeholders, application teams, compliance partners, and security teams to execute and continuously improve access certification programs while ensuring a secure, scalable, and compliant Identity Governance environment. The successful candidate will possess advanced SailPoint IdentityIQ expertise and a strong understanding of access governance best practices, operational processes, and modern Identity Governance capabilities.
 The ideal candidate is a hands-on practitioner who enjoys solving complex business problems, designing scalable solutions, driving operational excellence, and modernizing access governance through automation, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identity Access Reviews & Certifications 
 Configure, execute, monitor, and optimize enterprise access review and certification campaigns.
 Support manager, application owner, entitlement, role, and privileged access certifications.
 Drive adoption of Intelligent Access Reviews by integrating/onboarding different types of applications like JDBC, Web services, Out of box connectors etc.
 Improve certification effectiveness through automation, analytics, and continuous process improvements.
 Partner with business stakeholders to ensure timely completion of certifications and remediation activities.
 Develop and operationalize certification metrics, dashboards, reports, and compliance evidence.
 Support internal and external audit activities related to access governance and certification controls.
 Identify opportunities to modernize access review processes and enhance reviewer experience.
  
 Identity Governance Operations & Support 
 Maintain Identity Governance platforms and provide advanced operational support.
 Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, work on incidents & requests and implement sustainable resolutions.
 Monitor platform health, integrations, and governance processes to ensure stability and reliability.
 Support/execute periodic platform upgrades, enhancements, new integrations, enhancements, custom solution building, patching activities and configuration improvements.
 Ensure compliance with established governance, risk, and security requirements.
 Collaborate with technical teams to resolve integration, provisioning, and governance-related issues.
  
 Solution Design & Application Onboarding 
 Design and implement scalable, sustainable, and future-ready Identity Governance solutions both out of box & custom.
 Onboarding of new applications, entitlements, and identity sources into the SailPoint platform.
 Configure and enhance identity governance processes, workflows, certification models, and governance controls.
 Develop custom solutions, workflows, rules, reports, and integrations to address business requirements.
 Partner with application and infrastructure teams to strengthen governance controls across the enterprise.
 Contribute to platform standardization efforts and continuous improvement initiatives.
 AI & Governance Innovation 
 Understand AI and emerging technology trends and their applicability within Identity Governance.
 Evaluate opportunities to leverage AI capabilities for access certifications, access recommendations, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and governance analytics.
 Support adoption of intelligent and data-driven access review capabilities that improve efficiency and decision-making.
 Collaborate with stakeholders to identify innovative approaches that simplify governance processes and reduce operational burden.
 Qualifications & Experience 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related discipline.
 5 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Identity Governance & Administration (IGA).
 Advanced hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ.
 Strong experience with Access Reviews, Certification Campaigns, and Access Governance processes.
 Experience supporting application onboarding and governance integrations.
 Strong Knowledge of identity lifecycle management, role management, provisioning, and governance controls.
 Strong understanding of security principles, access control models, and compliance requirements.
 Experience working in large enterprise environments.
 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
 Technical Skills 
 SailPoint IdentityIQ (Advanced)
 Access Certifications and Governance
 Identity Lifecycle Management
 Role/Attrbiute-Based Access Control (RBAC)
 LDAP and Active Directory
 REST APIs and Web Services
 Java and BeanShell
 Web Services
 Linux and Tomcat
 SQL database
 Reporting and Analytics
 Identity Governance Architecture and Design
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with SailPoint IdentityNow / Identity Security Cloud.
 Experience with regulated environments and compliance frameworks such as SOX.
 Experience with AI-driven governance, identity analytics, or intelligent access review capabilities.
 Familiarity with ServiceNow, CyberArk, Entra ID, Active Directory, Ping, LDAP, Code repository, Ping and enterprise IAM ecosystems.
 Industry certifications in Identity, Security, or Governance disciplines.
 Key Competencies 
 Advanced knowledge of SailPoint IdentityIQ architecture, core concepts, capabilities, and best practices.
 Strong understanding of Identity Governance concepts and access certification methodologies.
 Ability to design scalable, supportable, and future-focused governance solutions.
 Strong operational mindset with a focus on reliability, quality, and compliance.
 Continuous improvement and automation orientation.
 Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and a global environment.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. 
 How We Work 
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities.  Key Responsibilities 
 Design, build, and support analytics-ready data products, curated datasets, and reusable transformation assets within a modern lakehouse environment to enable commercial reporting, self-service analytics, and business insights. 
 Translate business and analytics requirements into clear data specifications, dimensional models, metrics definitions, and dataset readiness criteria aligned to internal modeling and delivery standards. 
 Develop and maintain scalable SQL- and Python-based transformation logic that integrates structured and semi-structured pharma datasets such as claims, patient, sales, payer, HUB, and specialty pharmacy data. 
 Apply internally developed accelerators, reusable code patterns, templates, and engineering guardrails to improve development speed, consistency, and maintainability across data products. 
 Create analytics-friendly models, including fact and dimension tables, cross-domain joins, slowly changing dimensions, and business-rule-driven metrics that support dashboard, reporting, and advanced analytics consumption. 
 Implement standardized data quality checks, reconciliation logic, validation routines, and anomaly detection controls to ensure datasets are accurate, complete, and trusted by downstream users. 
 Document data products, metric definitions, lineage, assumptions, and known limitations in accordance with internal documentation and governance standards. 
 Work as part of a deployed engineering team embedded alongside an assigned Commercial business domain, partnering with data engineers, analysts, BI developers, and business stakeholders to support dashboard and reporting use cases. 
 Apply data governance standards, access controls, and compliant handling practices for sensitive and regulated data, including PII/PHI awareness. 
 Skills & Competencies 
 Strong proficiency in SQL for analytics transformations, data modeling, validation, and performance tuning. 
 Working knowledge of Python for data preparation, validation, automation, and analytical workflows. 
 Experience developing analytics-ready datasets using dimensional modeling concepts such as facts, dimensions, grains, keys, and slowly changing dimensions. 
 Familiarity with ETL/ELT patterns, lakehouse concepts, and medallion architecture, including bronze, silver, and gold/refined layers. 
 Hands-on familiarity with Databricks notebooks, jobs/workflows, and Delta Lake concepts. 
 Understanding of semantic layer concepts, metric definitions, and how curated datasets support BI, dashboards, and self-service analytics. 
 Experience with data quality practices including profiling, cleansing, standardization, reconciliation, and anomaly detection. 
 Working knowledge of governance and secure data handling practices, including documentation, lineage, and access controls. 
 Familiarity with BI/visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI. 
 Understanding of engineering practices such as Git/version control, code reviews, and basic CI/CD concepts. 
 Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. 
 Willingness to work as part of a deployed team embedded within a business domain, learning to adapt to domain-specific priorities. 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 A bachelor s or master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics/Mathematics, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 1–3 years of hands-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, or a related role building curated datasets and analytics-ready assets. 
 Experience transforming large-scale structured and semi-structured datasets using SQL and Python, with attention to data quality and performance. 
 Preferred: experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, or lakehouse architecture. 
 Preferred: experience working with commercial pharma datasets such as claims, sales, payer, patient, HUB, or specialty pharmacy data. 
 Preferred: exposure to BI/reporting use cases, semantic layer design, or dashboard-ready data modeling.
